name: profile-capture-isolation
goal: Independent runtime observation producers and successive flushes retain distinct immutable capture chunks with no overwritten evidence.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The one-pass API introduced at5790bba3 keys capture paths by unit, callable, workload and completion only. Independent producers or repeated flushes share that key and can overwrite earlier observation bytes. Reproduce before connecting standard workers.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The standard profiler suite covers separate workloads and clearing one flush, but not multiple producers or successive chunks for the same workload. Extend that suite with distinct producer instances and repeated flushes, asserting unique paths and intact per-chunk samples.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed redef47b89822ea89ad633bacfbe991f4f0858f476e0e6b673a7cad1f942007f33d at6e13136c reproduces both same-workload batch overwrites and independent/flush observation overwrites. Six other profiling cases pass.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Separate comparable workload identity from immutable capture identity. Preserve the workload group hash and add a unique chunk suffix for both batch and one-pass captures; keep values, sampling and performance limits unchanged. Enforce multiple producers and repeated chunks in the standard suite before runner integration.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Both capture paths retain stable workload grouping and add a unique chunk identifier after sampling. All23 focused tests, types and source audit pass. The local skill now requires producer/chunk isolation coverage before worker profiling and validates successfully.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same-process sealed red459cdef0b621e1a13a4c4bb838e31ae5bfeafc2a947868bb8c6acfe28ddf391d at6e13136c and green4ef2332c13c177fd4637a875c48e7453133afe4b5e8b3c45412ffe8eaad94eb2 at81ade8b1 pass unchanged eight-test corpus. Four actual profiler self-observations are retained.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The immutable red snapshot overwrites repeated batch captures and all three same-workload observation chunks. The green snapshot passes the same tests with three distinct chunk paths and intact per-chunk samples, without changing values or sampling.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
